{{Top|leg}}
A '''Corellian vinaigrette''' was a [[Salad/Legends|salad]] dressing that presumably originated from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was usually served on fresh greens from the world of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] topped by crushed [[pulta nut]]s. This type of meal was favored by the [[Aargauun]]s.<ref name="aargau">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030814aargau2|series=Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs|text=Part 2: Secure Lines of Credit}}</ref>
